mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEWS (performance_id, user_id, content, rating, contains_spoiler, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{performanceId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{containsSpoiler}, #{insId}, #{insIp})
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.performance_id AS performanceId, r.user_id AS userId, r.content, r.rating, r.contains_spoiler AS containsSpoiler, r.use_yn AS useYn, r.ins_de AS insDe, u.user_nm AS userNm FROM REVIEWS r JOIN USERS u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.performance_id = #{performanceId} AND r.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.ins_de DESC

SELECT review_id AS reviewId, performance_id AS performanceId, user_id AS userId, content, rating, contains_spoiler AS containsSpoiler, use_yn AS useYn, ins_de AS insDe FROM REVIEWS WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEWS SET content = #{content}, rating = #{rating}, contains_spoiler = #{containsSpoiler}, upt_id = #{uptId}, upt_ip = #{uptIp} WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
